sn11.22:1.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, aññataro yakkho dubbaṇṇo okoṭimako sakkassa devānamindassa āsane nisinno ahosi.
sn11.22:1.4: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave devā tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn11.22:1.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
sn11.22:1.6: ayaṃ yakkho dubbaṇṇo okoṭimako sakkassa devānamindassa āsane nisinnoti
sn11.22:1.7: yathā yathā kho bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti, tathā tathā so yakkho abhirūpataro ceva hoti dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro ca.
sn11.22:2.1: atha kho bhikkhave devā tāvatiṃsā yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn11.22:2.2: idha te mārisa aññataro yakkho dubbaṇṇo okoṭimako tumhākaṃ āsane nisinno.
sn11.22:2.3: tatra sudaṃ mārisa devā tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn11.22:2.4: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn11.22:2.5: ayaṃ yakkho dubbaṇṇo okoṭimako sakkassa devānamindassa āsane nisinnoti.
sn11.22:2.6: yathā yathā kho mārisa devā tāvatiṃsā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti, tathā tathā so yakkho abhirūpataro ceva hoti dassanīyataro ca pāsādikataro cāti.
sn11.22:2.7: so hi nūna mārisā kodhabhakkho yakkho bhavissatī ti.
sn11.22:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo yena so kodhabhakkho yakkho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā yena so kodhabhakkho yakkho tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ nāmaṃ sāveti:
sn11.22:3.2: sakko’haṃ mārisa devānamindo, sakko’haṃ mārisa devānamindoti.
sn11.22:3.3: yathā yathā kho bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo nāmaṃ sāveti tathā tathā so yakkho dubbaṇṇataro ceva ahosi okoṭimakataro ca
sn11.22:3.4: dubbaṇṇataro ceva hutvā okoṭimakataro ca tatthevantaradhāyīti.
sn11.22:3.5: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo sake āsane nisīditvā deve tāvatiṃse anunayamāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
